build_settings.release: Release; FAST_BUILD=ON; BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON; BUILD_TESTING=ON; ALL_TESTS=ON; HIPO=OFF

verification_method: Retained build/test receipts and independent source/artifact review; publication preparation did not rebuild or solve
test_scope_limits: Natural rgn root scheduling demonstrates real origin wiring and a finite applied cap at 4%; the cap need not expire
Actual timeout, accepted returned candidate and exhaustion are demonstrated separately by a prepared parent with fixture lower bound 77
Parent continuation in the prepared fixture is demonstrated by unset status and checkLimits plus further child/import operations, not completion of a new full parent search
Retained test receipts were verified, not rerun
Cooperative limits can overshoot; credit excludes parent preparation/import and untimed cleanup
LeakSanitizer was disabled; no leak-safety claim.
18 C-API runs form 6 exact old-control/off/observe triples; this is selected regression evidence, not equivalence for every instance.

replay.method: fresh official git archive; git apply --check and git apply (without index) for the three ordered patches; complete frozen file-inventory comparison

driver_unit_tests.scope: The synthetic separator cases use small direct-network factorizations with mocked matrix witnesses. No optimizer, real benchmark input, model generation or HiGHS API call was used by the unit suite.

option_metadata.source_basis: HighsOptions.h initializes the local advanced flag to false before these registrations and changes it to true later. This metadata clarification does not change the frozen source or runtime.
